target: PDT-II targets (1)/(2): test whether generic compositional economy/minimal graded-carrier principles can force same-sector closure or select n=3.

hypotheses: A primitive n-dimensional sector may complete into a standard graded carrier needed for recursive composition.
Physical economy is represented by minimizing carrier dimension per primitive dimension.
No n-specific constant or target dimension is inserted into the cost.
candidate_principle.claim_tested: Minimizing standard completion overhead selects n=3 or supplies a non-circular reason for same-sector closure.

full_exterior_or_clifford.proof: f(n+1)/f(n)=2n/(n+1); equality at n=1 and strict increase for n>1.

even_clifford.proof: Exactly one half of the full-completion overhead.

dimension_stress.analytic_extension: The monotonicity proofs cover all positive integer n, not only the stress dimensions.

scope_guard: This falsifies these canonical dimension-economy selectors, not every possible PDT-native resource functional. Norm, dynamics, thermodynamics, pure/mixed-state and Markovian distinctions are orthogonal to these particular costs because the costs depend only on carrier dimension.
prior_art_boundary: The graded dimensions dim Lambda^k(V)=C(n,k), dim Lambda(V)=2^n, and dim Cl(V,Q)=2^n are standard mathematics and are not claimed as PDT novelty.
pdt_consequence: A non-circular n=3 derivation cannot appeal merely to minimal dimension or relative overhead of these standard graded completions. PDT needs an independently derived operational/resource cost whose form is physically justified and whose n=3 minimum is not inserted by construction.
next_obligation: Derive or falsify a PDT-native same-operational-type/resource law that distinguishes admissible output sectors operationally rather than by generic carrier size.
same_input_prediction_status: OPEN: no P_PDT != P_QM prediction follows from this no-go.
gravity_capacity_status: OPEN / NOT ATTACKED: no gravity law imported.
